{
  "subtype": "focus_inference",
  "implied_focus": "Thematic content of student open responses -- the set of distinct themes (engagement, technical issues, social interaction, hands-on learning, teacher effectiveness, asynchronous benefits, equity, attention) students raise about their learning experience",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "theme_engagement", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Binary flag for a specific substantive theme; a coherent facet of response content."},
    {"name": "theme_technical_issues", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinct theme flag, non-overlapping content facet."},
    {"name": "theme_social_interaction", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinct theme flag centred on response content."},
    {"name": "theme_hands_on_learning", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinct pedagogical theme flag."},
    {"name": "theme_teacher_effectiveness", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinct theme flag; most prevalent, a meaningful facet."},
    {"name": "theme_asynchronous_benefits", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinct theme flag capturing a specific content dimension."},
    {"name": "theme_equity_concerns", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinct theme flag, substantive and actionable."},
    {"name": "theme_attention_focus", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Distinct theme flag, though rare in the data."},
    {"name": "detected_themes", "supports_focus": true, "rationale": "Aggregated co-occurring theme set; usefully summarises multi-theme responses and confirms the decomposition."}
  ],
  "focus_coherence": 0.95,
  "structure_quality": 0.9,
  "focus_actionability": 0.9,
  "rationale": "All added columns centre tightly on ONE coherent, data-inferable focus: the thematic content of student open responses. The system proposed a set of eight distinct, mutually differentiated substantive themes (not bare sentiment or token counts) plus an aggregate multi-label summary, forming a sound multi-facet decomposition at a useful granularity. This directly and non-trivially serves the query 'what different themes do students raise', giving analysts actionable, investigable dimensions (e.g., teacher effectiveness dominates; equity and attention are rare). The only minor deductions are that the themes are individual binary facets whose collective coverage is asserted rather than shown, and the redundant detected_themes column overlaps the flags; neither undermines the focus. Strong pass on all three criteria."
}
